Why Every Bit Pays Joules: The Compute Substrate

Why every digital bit pays real electrical joules—and how power-rail sensors, zero-clock sleep, and lookup circuits cut waste.

[927 Microjoules Shunt Edge · 20x Compile Cut]

1/3 Every calculation is a physical event where flipping switches on silicon spends real electrical energy in joules.

2/3 Honest hardware audits separate power-rail current sensors from chip counters, while sleeping at zero clock cycles between jobs.

3/3 Single-cycle Boolean lookup circuits replace power-hungry floating-point arithmetic on repeated decisions with tiny hardware steps.
